title: Correction: ask for date_diff start and end columns
description: When a duration request does not name both date columns, ask the user to identify the start and end columns before generating date_diff.
planner_guidance: The clarification should ask for two concrete existing columns and whether invalid date values should raise an error or become missing values.

example.question: Which two date columns should I compare, and should invalid dates fail the workflow or become missing values?

rag_note: MVP4 date_diff supports days only; do not propose weeks or months yet.
